content.short: Monsterra is a multi-chain P2E game on BNB Chain, Avalanche, OKTC, and Cosmos.
content.description: Monsterra blends free-to-play and free-to-earn gameplay, letting players enjoy entertaining experiences while pursuing potential profits with no upfront investment. The game provides utilities for both NFTs and tokens, a land-shaping system with highly customizable options, and a breeding mechanism across five races with unique DNAs. It offers six Dynamic Battle Modes (PvE and PvP), clan features, and a suite of mini-games. In addition, token and NFT staking supports growth and scalable expansion.
